title: Three Kinds of Flour
transcript: My grandfather taught me to make bread without using a written recipe. He would show me how the dough should feel and then let me try it myself. When I moved away, I bought the cheapest flour I could find, but my first loaf was hard as a rock. I called my grandfather, who asked me to read the label. I had bought flour intended for cakes. My next loaf was much better, and now I check the bag before every purchase.

questions.prompt: What was wrong with the first loaf after the move?
options: It did not have enough salt.
questions.explanation: hard as a rock 表示面包硬得像石头。

questions.prompt: What did the speaker find out from the label?
options: The flour was past its date.
The bag contained two kinds of flour.
The flour came from another country.
The flour was meant for cakes.
questions.answer: The flour was meant for cakes.
questions.explanation: 标签显示买成了做蛋糕用的面粉。
